title: I made a tiny world model game that runs locally on iPhone
author: howthefrondsfold
selftext: It's a bit experimental but I've been working on training my own local world model that runs on iPhone. Last weekend I made this driving game that tries to interpret any photo into controllable gameplay. It's pretty unstable but is still fun to mess around with the goopiness of the world model. I'm hoping to create a full gameloop at some point and share my process.

comments.author: Aromatic-Low-4578
comments.body: Forgive my ignorance but what exactly is a world model? Is it a diffusion model that generates frames and accepts inputs or something that generates a 3d environment that is then used in a typical game way?

replies.author: howthefrondsfold
replies.body: Hey! Thanks for the interest. You'll get a lot of world model definitions (and there is the official academic definition), but in this situation a 'world model' is frame-by-frame generation of pixels given previous frame(s) and control signals from the player.

replies.author: corysama
replies.body: A diffusion model that accepts inputs and generates a video in real time.
